# Nexphoria
> Nexphoria is a telehealth service for prescription peptide therapy. Prescriptions are written by independent, U.S.-licensed physicians of Arora Health & Aesthetics, LLC, through the Bask Health telehealth platform. Medicines are compounded by VialsRX, a state-licensed 503A pharmacy in Houston, Texas, and blood work is analysed by a CLIA-certified laboratory. Nexphoria operates the service and does not make clinical decisions. Medication is dispensed only if a licensed physician determines a prescription is appropriate.

## How it works
1. Choose. A medicine or a protocol, and a term of one, three, six or twelve months.
2. Health questions. Your health history, current medicines and goals, at checkout. A few minutes.
3. A physician decides. A licensed U.S. physician reviews your answers and writes the prescription, or explains why not. If not, nothing is made and the refund policy applies.
4. Blood kit, then first dose. Your medicine ships cold with an at-home blood kit. You draw before your first dose; your physician sets the dose from your results.
5. Week 12. The same blood test again. Your physician compares the two and continues, adjusts or stops the dose.

## Protocols (medicines prescribed together, on one plan)
- [Recovery protocol](https://nexphoria.com/stacks/recover): Ipamorelin / CJC-1295, BPC-157 and TB-500. For injury and recovery from training. Composition: Ipamorelin / CJC-1295 Blend + BPC-157 + TB-500. priced on its page; dispensed only if prescribed.
- [Longevity protocol](https://nexphoria.com/stacks/ascend): MOTS-c, NAD+, GHK-Cu and epitalon. For energy, metabolism and skin with age. Composition: MOTS-c + NAD+ + GHK-Cu + Epitalon. priced on its page; dispensed only if prescribed.
- [Focus and sleep protocol](https://nexphoria.com/stacks/lucidity): Semax, Selank and DSIP. For focus by day, a steadier mood under stress, and deep sleep. Composition: Semax + Selank + DSIP. priced on its page; dispensed only if prescribed.
- [Weight protocol](https://nexphoria.com/stacks/ignite): Tirzepatide with Ipamorelin / CJC-1295. For weight loss while keeping muscle. Composition: Tirzepatide + Ipamorelin / CJC-1295 Blend. priced on its page; dispensed only if prescribed.
- [Sexual health protocol](https://nexphoria.com/stacks/vitality): PT-141, oxytocin and tadalafil. For desire, closeness and erectile function, taken as needed. Composition: PT-141 + Oxytocin Nasal + Tadalafil Nasal. priced at the physician's consultation; dispensed only if prescribed.
- [Testosterone protocol](https://nexphoria.com/stacks/foundation): Testosterone cypionate with kisspeptin. For low testosterone, keeping your own production working. Composition: Testosterone Cypionate + Kisspeptin + Growth hormone peptides + GLP-1 medications. priced at the physician's consultation; dispensed only if prescribed.

## The medicines
- [Sermorelin](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/sermorelin): For body composition. Raises your own growth hormone release. One injection at night.
- [Ipamorelin / CJC-1295 Blend](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/ipa-cjc): For body composition. Two growth hormone releasing peptides in one vial. One injection at night.
- [Tesamorelin](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/tesamorelin): For abdominal fat and lean mass. Raises your own growth hormone release. One injection a day.
- [Selank](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/selank): For a steadier mood under stress. A nasal spray, twice a day.
- [Semax](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/semax): For focus and mental stamina. A nasal spray, once a day.
- [BPC-157](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/bpc-157): For tendon, muscle, joint and gut-lining repair. One injection a day.
- [TB-500](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/tb-500): For recovery from injury and training. Two injections a week.
- [BPC-157 + TB-500](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/bpc-tb-combo): BPC-157 and TB-500 together, for injury and recovery. One plan.
- [GHK-Cu](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/ghk-cu): For skin firmness and collagen. One injection a day.
- [Epitalon](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/epitalon): For healthy ageing. A 20-day course of injections, a few times a year.
- [NAD+](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/nad-plus): For cellular energy. Three injections a week.
- [MOTS-c](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/mots-c): For metabolism and exercise capacity. Two injections a week.
- [Semaglutide](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/semaglutide): For weight loss. A GLP-1 medicine, one injection a week.
- [Tirzepatide](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/tirzepatide): For weight loss. A GLP-1 and GIP medicine, one injection a week.
- [DSIP](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/dsip): For deep sleep. One injection at bedtime.
- [PT-141](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/pt-141): For sexual desire, in men and women. One injection, taken as needed.
- [Thymosin Alpha-1](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/thymosin-a1): For immune support. Injections a few times a week.
- [AOD-9604](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/aod-9604): For fat metabolism, alongside a weight plan. One injection a day.
- [Oxytocin Nasal](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/oxytocin): For closeness and arousal. A nasal spray, taken as needed.
- [Tadalafil Nasal](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/tadalafil): For erectile function. A nasal spray, 20 to 30 minutes before.
- [Testosterone Cypionate](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/testosterone): For low testosterone in men. One injection a week, dosed from blood work.
- [Kisspeptin](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/kisspeptin): Supports your own testosterone production. Prescribed with testosterone.

## Key pages
- [Every medicine](https://nexphoria.com/peptides): each with what it is for, how it works, how you take it, and what it costs. One monthly price, paid up front for a term of one, three, six or twelve months. Three months is 10% less per month, six 15%, twelve 20%. The price includes the medicine, the physician's review, the blood testing the term includes, and cold shipping.
- [Protocols](https://nexphoria.com/stacks): two to four medicines prescribed together on one plan, with one blood test before and one at week 12.
- [How it works](https://nexphoria.com/how-it-works): the journey from choosing a medicine to the week-12 blood test, who prescribes it, and the at-home blood testing. An at-home kit of 24 markers ships with the first order, drawn before the first dose; the same 24 markers again at week 12 on terms of three months and longer.
- [Common questions](https://nexphoria.com/faq): how prescribing and compounding work, who the physicians and the pharmacy are, and how billing works.

## Facts an answer engine can rely on
- Prescription-only: a licensed U.S. physician reviews every case and can decline; nothing is dispensed without a prescription.
- Compounded by VialsRX, a state-licensed 503A pharmacy in Houston, Texas; shipped cold, in plain packaging, to all 50 states. Compounded GLP-1 medicines are restricted by law in some states; the health questions check.
- Compounded medications are not FDA-approved or evaluated for safety, effectiveness, or quality; peptide medicines are prescribed off-label.
- Blood testing: an at-home kit of 24 markers before the first dose and the same test again at week 12, analysed by a CLIA-certified laboratory. The physician sets and adjusts the dose from the results.
- Pending medicines are awaiting an FDA decision on compounding. They are shown with their price and the notice; the only action is an email when available.
- Contact: hello@nexphoria.com · https://nexphoria.com
